Mapjects operates a centralized logistics operations portal platform and provides Java development services for federal work. The Java Developer will support application design, development, prototyping, modeling, interfaces, and web services in a team environment.
Java application developer building web services, supporting business analysis, and performing functional testing

Responsibilities:
• This position is responsible for supporting design and development in a team environment
• You will support application development, prototyping, modeling
• You will support interfaces, and web services, WSDL
• Business Analysis/ client facing
• Functional Testing
• Communication skills

Requirements:
• US citizens only
• development of new or existing web-based applications For e.g.  Java, (or Java -Servlets, JSP, JSF, XML, J2EE, Web Services. )
• BS in an Information Systems ***or some equiv** related field of study

Preferred:
• Strong analytical and creative problem solving skills
• A senior-level professional who is a motivated and effective team player
• Experience with working on Agile project teams
• Communication skills
